# Fixture provenance

**No fixtures captured yet** — the roadmap is Draft and nothing may be built until a
live capture lands here (procedure: `../METRICS-CAPTURE.md`).

When capturing, record for each batch:

- MTO version (CSV / image tag) and install method (OperatorHub / Helm)
- Cluster platform + version (e.g. OpenShift 4.x)
- Date, namespace, which optional components (db, extensions) were installed
- Cluster state at capture time (tenants present, any induced error states)
